changes.title: Treehouse deck
items: The treehouse is now a round deck up on the Ent: land on it from the treetops, walk round it, and time runs ten times slower while you're up there
Your DJ decks sit along the deck's front edge, where each night starts
The world map stands in the deck's middle: press E at it to open the sea chart and sail off from there whenever you like (mid-night, that ends the night unwon)

changes.title: Archipelago
items: The sea chart's islands are packed over the whole sea instead of sitting on rings: clusters and open water, each island still roughly in its direction and further out by phase
Neighbouring islands' coasts follow each other across a strait, and no island overlaps another

changes.title: Hats b
items: Five more hats to pick in your room's Hat box
Bramble: wild creatures within 30 m of it are slowed
Mine: put it down and it stuns wild creatures within 15 m
Lullaby: put it down and wild creatures nearby fall asleep; a 💌 wakes one up
Cyclone: a whirlwind sweeps creatures round it, lifts them up and flings them away
Nursing: your own creatures near it heal
